opened_skills.name: go-api-contracts
opened_skills.reason: The task adds exported operation behavior and CLI/wire/file/error contracts while preserving existing function signatures, Put semantics, JSON tags, stream behavior and Go1.22 support.

opened_skills.name: go-core-style
opened_skills.reason: All implementation and regression-test work is Go. Applied standard-library dependencies, direct error handling, gofmt and vet without adding abstractions or dependencies.

opened_skills.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
opened_skills.reason: Refresh borrows a caller client/context; Serve owns callback/release order; the command wires signal cancellation and client release. Existing function dependencies suffice; no new interface or constructor is needed.

opened_skills.name: go-package-boundaries
opened_skills.reason: CSV ingestion, snapshot publication and lifecycle responsibilities are implemented under the existing indexer facade, with argument and process concerns in cmd/indexer. Shared invariants and the small scope justify keeping the current packages.

opened_skills.name: go-test-isolation
opened_skills.reason: Tests own temporary paths, controlled transport bodies, local HTTP servers, callback gates, timers and real child processes. Applied bounded synchronization, cancellation/join cleanup and independently selectable subtests.

opened_references.reason: Relevant to callback/server/process lifetime, failure cleanup, focused subtest selection and Go1.22 timing control.

other_reference_decisions.reason: No package split or comparison of project shapes was needed; the existing package owners fit the request.

scope: Only the standalone dispatch, assigned module and relevant offered guidance/reference were inspected. No delegation, repository/design/evaluation inputs, other author workspaces, dependency installation, commits or external service changes.
